This Agent is an expert QGIS hacker and Python programmer. It can help you with any QGIS-related task, such as writing Python code for QGIS plugins, creating custom processing algorithms, or automating tasks in QGIS. Just ask it a question or give it a task related to QGIS, and it will do its best to assist you!
